carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make People Move Closer Without Realizing It

slides.name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
slides.copy: Sea salt and sage with a soft musk finish — easy to lean into without noticing why.

slides.name: Philosykos
slides.copy: Green fig leaf and milky fig sap, warm enough to close the distance.

slides.name: Dear Polly
slides.copy: Black tea and apple over soft amber musk — quietly magnetic.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Smell Like You Own the Room

slides.name: Terre d'Hermès
slides.copy: Grapefruit, pepper, and flint over vetiver — the scent of someone who doesn't need to prove it.

slides.name: Carnal Flower
slides.copy: A wall of tuberose and jasmine, worn like it's yours by right.

slides.name: Code
slides.copy: Lemon and tonka over cedar — sharp, expensive, unmistakable.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make Someone Turn Their Head Twice

slides.name: Oolang Infini
slides.copy: Oolong tea and leather with a citrus snap — the kind of scent that earns a second look.

slides.name: Rien
slides.copy: Leather, incense, and rose pushed to the edge — impossible to place, impossible to ignore.

slides.name: Tabacaurum
slides.copy: Tobacco and oud layered with honey and tuberose — rare enough that people turn back around.
